dry_run.description: `true` only on a `dry_run` reply, where nothing was committed.

item.description: `dry_run` only: the item as it would be stored (`proposed_by` set).

plan_precondition.description:
`dry_run` only: digest of the case's plan as it would be after the add
(ref `plan:<case_id>`). Pass it as a precondition on the real call.

proposed_by.description:
The actor the identity gate verified — the proposer of record. A
client-supplied `proposed_by` is overwritten, never trusted.

expected_digest.description: The sha256 digest the caller expects the referenced record to have.
